lesson.title: Warning
lesson.theory:
Before starting the course i recomend you to check IPA and go through every sound in that list
a, b, k, d, ε, f, g, h/x, i, ʒ, l, m, n, o, p, kj, r, s, t, u, y, v, ks, z
That's because creating the sound reading program is a big headache and a lot of sounds aren't as accurate as they should be, a lot of sounds the reader reads not quite correctly and this can cause problems in future

lesson.title: Thanks
lesson.theory: Thank you for your attention, we hope you will not get problems with reading our words
